requirements.text: ESP32-C3 boots and recognizes both PCA9685 I2C devices.
Firmware writes all 20 logical actuator channels.
At a 1500-mm target the range sensor reads 1500 mm and obstacle interlock clears.

proven_scope: The saved firmware boots, initializes two PCA9685 register models, writes 20 logical actuator channels, and reads the scripted range/IMU inputs through its original declared serial oracles.
unverified_scope: PCA9685-driven servo twin outputs on deployed app until PR #3676 is merged and deployed
motor/servo external power rails (20 PWR_SUPPLY_UNCONNECTED warnings)
real servo angular motion, torque, load and OE failure negative control
physical KernelCAD joint graph and collision-safe motion
